approval.basis: The user requested completion of every remaining cross-surface Tutorial migration
approval.notes: This parity plan extends the approved tutorial-coverage expansion without changing the fixture budgets or the completed documentation-renovation architecture.

tutorial_project_policy.rule: Define one biological figure first, then teach that same figure through GUI, CLI, and Python API variants.
tutorial_project_policy.navigation: Every implemented variant links to the other variants through a Choose how to build this figure table.
tutorial_project_policy.exceptions: A surface may be marked unavailable only when it cannot express the figure; it must name the missing capability and must not substitute a different figure.
tutorial_project_policy.migration: Existing single-surface projects remain explicit backlog items; new projects must not be added as partial projects.
